The '''Dynamet Corporation''' was active in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the forces of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In [[4056 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dynamet General}} states that [[Dynamet General Hospital|Mercy General]] was renamed a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[destruction of Taris]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[3956 BBY]]. Thus, the [[Medcenter|hospital]] was renamed in [[4056 BBY]].</ref> the corporation donated a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Medcenter|hospital]] [[Dynamet General Hospital|Mercy General]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in order to fund a wing dedicated to developing a cure for Taris's [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. The company's generosity led to the building being renamed to the Dynamet General Hospital.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dynamet Corporation was mentioned in the Codex entry for Dynamet General in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
